tool_calls.name: run_python
tool_calls.code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
df = pd.read_csv('daily_cost_1.csv')

# For each (account, service), compute rolling median / z-score of BilledCost
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['ChargePeriodStart'])

res = []
for (acct, svc), g in df.groupby(['SubAccountName','ServiceName']):
    g = g.sort_values('date')
    med = g['BilledCost'].median()
    mad = (g['BilledCost'] - med).abs().median()
    g = g.copy()
    g['med'] = med
    g['mad'] = mad if mad>0 else 1
    g['z'] = (g['BilledCost'] - med)/g['mad']
    res.append(g)

allg = pd.concat(res)
top = allg.sort_values('z', ascending=False).head(15)
print(top[['date','SubAccountName','ServiceName','BilledCost','med','z']].to_string())
